command.text: Theseus to Blue lead, we are reading inbound warheads and three wings of Cylon raiders. Intercept and destroy, we are scrambling other squadrons for launch.

lantern.text: This is Red 2 to Theseus. We have established contact with the Indart and she has tylium. We have neutralized a Cylon recon wing, but more might appear at any moment.

shadow.text: That's what I wanted to hear. I know you're worried about your sister. As soon as we can re-establish contact with the fleet, you'll be the first to know about what's happening on Virgon.

flask.text: Jump complete. I'm reading two DRADIS contacts, Cylon raiders. Might be a rear guard. They haven't detected our emissions yet. As long as we don't shoot or get too close we should be fine.

captain.text: A battlestar? The Indart doesn't have an FTL drive, so you'll need to bring your ship here. With baseships jumping into orbit you'll be taking one hell of a risk.

civilian.text: We... we found someone... We've been jumping all over the system, looking for anyone else still alive.

hauler.text: New contact! Cylon baseship! They've been toying with us the whole time... FTL is still down... We don't stand a chance!

ghost.text: Hang in there. We'll double back with an SAR bird. You have enough air for at least twelve hours, conserve it.

rook.text: Don't be thanking them so soon. Prometheus, we're going to need as much space on deck for those Evac Raptors as possible. Let's hope your drives are spooled before the toasters make a comeback.
